paite: Huchi in unaute aw, Pathian zahngaihna ziak in, kithoihna hing, siangthou leh Pathian lung tuak ding in na pumpi uh lan ding in ka hon ngen ahi; huai na biakna dan ding him uh ahi.
heading: Pathian Pomtak Kithoihna
english: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

paite: Hiai khovel dan bang in om kei unla; Pathian deihlam a hoih leh lungtuahhuaitak leh hoih bukim na theihtel theihna ding un, na lungsim uh athak a om in hong kikheng lamdang zawta un.
english: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

paite: Na lak uah kuamah na kiletsak ding hun val ua kiliansak lou in, Pathian in michih kiang a ginna hun apiak bang zel a diktak a ngaihtuah zaw ding in Pathian in ahon piak hehpihna ziak in ka hon chi chiat ahi.
heading: Kha Thilpiak Tan Bang Zel A Nasep
english: For I say, through the grace that was given me, to every man who is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

paite: Pumpi khat ah hiang tampi i nei ua, hiang tengteng nasep bel akibang kei hi,
english: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

paite: huchi mah bang in, eite tampi himah lehang Khrist ah pumpi khat i hi ua; atuamtuam in i kihiangtuah chiat uhi.
english: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another.

paite: Hehpihna ahon piakdan bang zel in thilthawnpiak tuamtuam i nei chiat uhi; thugen ding ahihleh i ginna toh kihun in i gen ding uhi;
english: Having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us, if prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

paite: Nasepna ahihleh tua anasepna mah ah sem hen; sinsakmi'n asinsakna ah sinsak hen;
english: or service, let us give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

paite: Hanthawn mi in ahanthawnna mah sem hen; thilpemi'n phaltak in pia hen; makaimi'n phatuamngaihna toh ma kai hen; zahngaihna nasemmi in kipaktak in sem hen.
english: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting: he who gives, let him do it with liberality; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

paite: Itna ahihleh lepchiahna tel lou in hi hen. Gilou hua unla, ahoih lam len tinten un.
heading: Khristiante Hindan Ding
english: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

paite: Unaute itna lam ah ittak in kilainattuah chiat un; pahtawi lam ah, kideihsaktuah chiat un.
english: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate one to another; in honor preferring one another;

paite: Thanop lam ah, thadah kei un; Kha a vakna toh phatuamngai in Toupa nna sem un.
english: not lagging in diligence; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

paite: Lametna ah kipak unla; gimthuakna ah kuhkal un; thumna ah thum teitei un;
english: rejoicing in hope; enduring in troubles; continuing steadfastly in prayer;

paite: Misiangthoute taksapna ah taksap awng hu unla; mikhualte kipahpih in om nilouh un.
english: contributing to the needs of the saints; given to hospitality.

paite: Hon sawite vualzawl un, vualzawl unla, hamsiat kei un.
english: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

paite: Kipakte kipahpih unla, kapte kahpih un.
english: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

paite: Ngaihtuah kibang in om chiat un, kingaihtuah sang lo kei unla, mi neuneu kithuahpih zaw un. Kipilsak kei un.
english: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

paite: Kua gitlouh leng gilou in thuk kei un. Mi tengteng muh in thil kilawm ngaihtuah un.
english: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

paite: Ahihtheih liaileh noumau lam bek, mi tengteng toh kituak in om un.
english: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

paite: Deihtakte aw, phu kila kei un, Pathian hehna awn zaw un, "Phulak himhim keimah lak ding ahi, ke'n ka thuk na ding, Toupa'n achi," chih gelh ahi.
english: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.” Deuteronomy 32:35

paite: Huaiziak in "Na melma agil akialleh nek ding pia inla; adang atakleh dawn ding pia in; huchibang a na hihleh alutung ah mei-am sekkhawm na hi ding hi."
english: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.” Proverbs 25:21-22

paite: Gitlouh zoh in om ke'nla, hoihna in gilou zou zaw in.
english: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
